description: This file defines the class CustomShippingQuoteWeightItem, which extends CustomShippingQuoteItem and implements JSONAware. It adds properties for maximumWeight and priceText, and provides methods to access and modify these properties, as well as a JSON serialization method.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuoteWeightItem
classes.description: A Java class extending CustomShippingQuoteItem, representing a shipping quote item with weight limits and JSON serialization capability.

methods.name: getPriceText
methods.description: Returns the price text associated with the shipping quote.

methods.name: setPriceText
methods.description: Sets the price text for the shipping quote.

methods.name: setMaximumWeight
methods.description: Sets the maximum weight limit for the item.

methods.name: getMaximumWeight
methods.description: Returns the maximum weight limit for the item.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the shipping quote item to a JSON string, including price and maximum weight.
